raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "email"
  role subject "Mark"
  role object "Dev"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "move out of"
  role subject "Mark"
  role object "the flat on Elm Grove"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "occur before"
  role subject "the email"
  role object "the move out"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  select ?t
  measure end
  where match
    relation "move out of"
    role subject "Mark"
    role object "the flat on Elm Grove"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
